summary: Tested the Emergent managed email setup on the backend and in the UI. Backend: 9/9 pytest checks passed (tests/test_email_emergent.py). GET /api/admin/settings reports email.provider='emergent' and does not expose smtp_pass. POST /api/admin/settings/email/test returns 200 {ok:true, provider:'emergent', to:qa.admin+clerk_test@example.com}, and the newest email_log entry is kind='test', status='sent', provider='emergent', with no _id. All 11 template previews render. Sending a sample (welcome, because no storybook sample exists) returned 200 and was logged as 'sent'. The admin endpoints return 401/403 without auth. The upstream Emergent API returned 202 Accepted (backend log). UI: signed in as the QA admin and opened /admin/settings. Clicking 'Send me a test email' showed the success toast 'Test email sent to qa.admin+clerk_test@example.com'. The previews for Welcome, Payment receipt, Admin invitation and Verification code show the correct subjects and branded HTML. Regressions: /api/, /api/store and the home page all return 200. In total 3 real emails were sent, all to the QA admin address.

minor.issue: The storybook_reminder, purchase (pack/storybook receipt) and referral_reward templates are not in email_templates.SAMPLES, so admins cannot preview or send a sample of them. The Storybook reminder in particular cannot be previewed.

ui_bugs.component: Admin Settings > Email templates preview iframe
ui_bugs.issue: The FlexoCards logo image is broken in the preview. craco.config.js sets the header Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin on every frontend asset, and a sandboxed srcDoc iframe has an opaque origin, so the browser blocks /logo-wordmark.png. Webmail clients that load images directly in the browser without a proxy would also show a broken logo in real emails.

action_items: Allow cross-origin loading of the email images: either set Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy to cross-origin for /logo-wordmark.png and the other email images, or relax the header in craco.config.js and the production server config. This fixes the broken logo in the preview and in some webmail clients.
Optional: add storybook_reminder, purchase and referral_reward to ET.SAMPLES so admins can preview them.
critical_code_review_comments: notify() uses asyncio.create_task and keeps no reference to the task. The event loop can garbage-collect such tasks before they finish. Keep the tasks in a module-level set.
_deliver catches only EmailError, ValueError and httpx.HTTPError. Any other exception escapes inside the background task, and no email_log entry is written for it.
The storybook reminder loop runs inside every backend worker. With more than one worker, the atomic update_one guard prevents duplicate emails, but each worker repeats the scan.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (one medium cosmetic issue: broken logo in the template preview)

seed_data_creation: None. 3 email_log entries were added: kind 'test' twice and 'sample:welcome' once, all sent to qa.admin+clerk_test@example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'cd /app/backend && python3 qa_users.py tokens' to get the admin bearer token (it prints JSON). Sign in through the Clerk UI with input[name=identifier], then .cl-formButtonPrimary, then input[name=password], then .cl-formButtonPrimary. Test IDs: email-test-button, email-template-{id}, email-template-preview (iframe), email-template-subject. The test email endpoint is rate limited (5) and always sends to the admin's own address.
